source: Michigan Lottery listed retail instant inventory

catalogs.coverage: Retail instant games listed in the official web lobby and available in stores, matched by official IGT ID where published. Listed games without inventory retain catalog price and top prize with unknown remaining counts. Prize inventory is not dated claims or retailer-linked winning activity. Pull Tabs and unlisted inventory rows are excluded.
catalogs.updateCadence: Checked every six hours; source cadence unconfirmed.
